# SkillHire

> SkillHire is a local-services marketplace that connects households and businesses with background-verified skilled workers — electricians, plumbers, cleaners, tutors, mechanics and more — across 45+ cities.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Search verified local pros, browse popular categories and featured workers.
- [All categories](/categories): Every service category available on SkillHire.
- [Search](/search): Filter workers by category, price, rating and availability.
- [Plumbing services](/services/plumbing): Hire a verified plumber near you.
- [About](/about): Mission, verification process and what makes SkillHire different.
- [Contact](/contact): Support and feedback channels.
